evidence.reason: AE-08 phase 8 step 7 (UD 7 paused in place, portable): a note, tempo or loop edit on a paused prepared session is adopted by that session instead of disposing and re-preparing it, so the paused-preview effect no longer disposes for an edit. Arm 468 (remove the paused replacement) re-points to the adoption call that replaced it in the same effect branch. Arm 470 (the baseline a re-run keeps) re-points to the baseline the paused adoption records. Arms 452, 465, 471 and rc2:404 lose B6f4 'a mixer edit ...' and 'a paused-preview re-run ...' (and 471 loses 'keeps a paused portable session compatible when enabling a loop') from their recorded failures: those tests only failed because the mutants broke the dispose and re-prepare that edits no longer take; each arm keeps other recorded failures (counts pass+1/fail-1 per removed test). The B6f4 re-run witness now also asserts that the re-run compiles and posts nothing, which keeps arms 470 and 471 (b6f4) killed. See PHASE8-STEP7-UD7P.md.
